prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve character asset. Reference image is a visual reference for character identity, costume, pose and painterly style, NOT a background to reproduce. Create ONE isolated character cutout asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha); no colored paper, no white rectangle, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no speech balloon, no calendar, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Match the attached Japanese children's book illustration closely: warm watercolor/gouache texture, fine soft dark-brown outlines, gentle natural proportions, expressive brown eyes, delicate shading, not glossy 3D and not anime redesign. Keep one consistent character identity. Girl: chestnut bob hair, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan with small buttons, cream shirt, teal pleated skirt. Boy: tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie over cream shirt. Final square 1536x1536 composition, character large with a small clear transparent margin around the entire subject. Never crop head, hair, fingers or required objects. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the girl riding the light-blue basket bicycle in the LARGE EVENT SCENE. Full girl plus ENTIRE bicycle including both circular wheels, tires, spokes, handlebars, basket, pedals and feet. Girl pedals toward SCREEN RIGHT in cheerful three-quarter side view; hands contact handlebars and feet contact pedals naturally. Same yellow star hairclip/coral cardigan/teal skirt/white socks/light sneakers. Reconstruct any occluded bicycle parts cleanly. Transparent gaps between spokes, bicycle frame and limbs, with no remaining park colors. No narrator copy: exactly one girl, one bicycle.
